purpose: Native core performance diagnosis after the reported OBrush0.1.3 browser lag, with exact same-input geometry preservation; no browser frame-rate measurement in this record.

timing_contract.timed: Separate current-surface raycast and apply_brush_with_result Draw/refinement calls, measured individually by Instant; combined is their sum.
timing_contract.excluded: Sphere generation, external diagnostics/snapshots, final metrics, OBJ/JSON serialization, history, app input queue, rendering, GPU upload, browser and native UI. Internal core snapshots/refinement are included.
timing_contract.quantiles: Sort durations ascending; p50 is value at floor(n/2), p95 at min(floor(.95*n),n-1). Mean is arithmetic mean.
timing_contract.repetitions: One initial frozen baseline native run and one optimized native run for primary pairing; one unmodified baseline export rerun retained as a repeat check. Separate instrumented and candidate1 intermediate runs are preserved.
timing_contract.measurement_limits: Wall time on this M2 includes OS/background scheduling and possible thermal variation; maxima/outliers are not hard real-time guarantees. Native CPU duration is not browser frame duration or application FPS.
timing_contract.fixture_field_scope: Fresh sphere defaults: all initial masks zero and colors uniform; exact field equality does not substitute for the separate painted/masked/imported-mesh regression tests.
